title: The Moon is NOT the Hottest Place!

scenes.text: The Moon is often believed to be the hottest place in our solar system.
Many people think the Moon experiences extreme temperatures due to sunlight.
scenes.label: Moon's Extreme Heat

scenes.text: In reality, the hottest place is actually the surface of Venus, with temperatures reaching over 900°F.
scenes.label: Venus is Hotter
Think Again!
scenes.sub: The Moon is cooler than Venus.
scenes.query: The Moon is NOT the Hottest Place!

scenes.text: Follow if curiosity runs your brain.

description: The Moon is thought to be extremely hot, but it's cooler than Venus. Follow for daily science!
